mapper.select: /*selectMasterMdCmCmsBuyInfoMapStdInfo*/ SELECT P.CMS_CATLG_ID , P.CMS_CATLG_ID || '-' || LPAD(TO_CHAR(P.CATLG_SEQ), 5, '0') AS BUY_INFO_ID , TRIM(TO_CHAR(P.CATLG_SEQ)) AS CATLG_SEQ , C.DESCRIPTION_LOC AS DESCRIPTION_LOC , C.MODEL_INFO AS MODEL_INFO , C.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION , (SELECT MD.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 MD WHERE MD.TYPE = 'M104' AND MD.CODE = C.MAKER_CODE) AS MAKER_NAME , (SELECT MD.TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 MD WHERE MD.TYPE = 'M001' AND MD.CODE = C.ORIGIN_CODE) AS ORIGIN_NAME , C.ORDER_MEASURE AS MEASURE , P.AGENT AS AGENT , (SELECT CMPY.COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE CMPY.COM_CODE = P.AGENT) AS VENDOR_NAME , RTRIM(TO_CHAR(P.BUY_PRICE, 'FM999,999,999,990.99999'), '.') AS BUY_PRICE , RTRIM(TO_CHAR(P.MIN_ORDER_QTY, 'FM999,999,990.999'), '.') AS MIN_ORDER_QTY , RTRIM(TO_CHAR(P.PUR_UNIT_QTY, 'FM999,999,990.999'), '.') AS PUR_UNIT_QTY , (SELECT MD.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 MD WHERE MD.TYPE = 'M186' AND MD.CODE = P.DELIVERY_TYPE) AS DELIVERY_TYPE , (SELECT MD.TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 MD WHERE MD.TYPE = 'M034' AND MD.CODE = P.PROCESS_TYPE) AS PROCESS_TYPE , (SELECT MD.TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 MD WHERE MD.TYPE = 'W001' AND MD.TEXT1 = P.WAREHOUSE_CODE) AS WAREHOUSE_NAME FROM CMSPRICE P, CMSCATLG C WHERE P.CMS_CATLG_ID = C.CMS_CATLG_ID AND P.CMS_CATLG_ID = SUBSTR(#{st_buy_info}, 1, INSTR(#{st_buy_info}, '-') - 1) AND P.CATLG_SEQ = TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(#{st_buy_info}, INSTR(#{st_buy_info}, '-') + 1))

/*selectMasterMdCmCmsBuyInfoMapCustList*/ SELECT Q.BUYER AS BUYER_CODE , (SELECT CMPY.COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE CMPY.COM_CODE = Q.BUYER) AS BUYER_NAME , (SELECT G.COMORG_CODE FROM KEP.BYCAORGL G WHERE G.COMORG_CODE = (SELECT CMPY.BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE CMPY.COM_CODE = Q.BUYER)) AS GROUP_CODE , (SELECT G.COMORG_NAME FROM KEP.BYCAORGL G WHERE G.COMORG_CODE = (SELECT CMPY.BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE CMPY.COM_CODE = Q.BUYER)) AS GROUP_NAME , Q.CONTRACT_NO AS CONTRACT_NO , Q.CONTRACT_SEQ AS CONTRACT_SEQ , Q.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO , Q.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION , Q.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION , Q.UNIT_MEASURE AS MEASURE , Q.AGENT AS AGENT , (SELECT CMPY.COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE CMPY.COM_CODE = Q.AGENT) AS VENDOR_NAME , NVL(Q.CSV_YN, 'N') AS CSV_YN , (SELECT DECODE(R.CONTRACT_FLAG, 'F', 'Y', 'N') FROM KEP_BUYER_RATE R WHERE R.BUYER = Q.BUYER AND R.TO_DATE = '299912') AS FEE_BASE_YN , (SELECT RTRIM(TO_CHAR(R.RATE, 'FM999,990.99'), '.') FROM KEP_BUYER_RATE R WHERE R.BUYER = Q.BUYER AND R.TO_DATE = '299912') AS FEE_BASE_RATE , RTRIM(TO_CHAR(Q.UNIT_PRICE, 'FM999,999,999,990.99999'), '.') AS UNIT_PRICE , SUBSTR(Q.FROM_DATE, 1, 8) AS FROM_DATE , SUBSTR(Q.TO_DATE, 1, 8) AS TO_DATE , Q.BUYER || '|' || Q.CONTRACT_NO || '|' || Q.CONTRACT_SEQ AS TCODE FROM ICOMCQDT Q WHERE Q.CMS_CATLG_ID = SUBSTR(#{st_buy_info}, 1, INSTR(#{st_buy_info}, '-') - 1) AND Q.CATLG_SEQ = TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(#{st_buy_info}, INSTR(#{st_buy_info}, '-') + 1)) ORDER BY Q.BUYER, Q.CONTRACT_NO, Q.CONTRACT_SEQ

/*selectMasterMdCmCmsBuyInfoMapTargetList*/ SELECT P.CMS_CATLG_ID || '-' || LPAD(TO_CHAR(P.CATLG_SEQ), 5, '0') AS BUY_INFO_ID , P.CMS_CATLG_ID AS CMS_CATLG_ID , P.AGENT AS AGENT , P.STATUS AS STATUS FROM CMSPRICE P WHERE (P.CMS_CATLG_ID, P.CATLG_SEQ) IN
(SUBSTR(#{item}, 1, INSTR(#{item}, '-') - 1), TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(#{item}, INSTR(#{item}, '-') + 1)))
